{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# The population is all sales records, as stated in the contract
# The campaign is defined as the entire dataset, as it is an export of a Q3 e-commerce campaign test

# Define success as a measurable improvement in sales
# We can evaluate success by comparing the overall conversion rate to a benchmark
# However, no benchmark is provided, so we must use the data itself

# Calculate total revenue
total_revenue = sales_df['revenue'].sum()

# Calculate total converted orders
total_converted = sales_df['converted'].sum()

# Calculate overall conversion rate
overall_conversion_rate = sales_df['converted'].mean()

# Check if there are any records with zero revenue but converted
zero_revenue_converted = sales_df[(sales_df['revenue'] == 0) & (sales_df['converted'] == 1)].shape[0]

# Print the results
print(f"Total revenue: {total_revenue}")
print(f"Total converted orders: {total_converted}")
print(f"Overall conversion rate: {overall_conversion_rate}")
print(f"Records with zero revenue but converted: {zero_revenue_converted}")"}
